title: Subgraph-Aware Training of Language Models for Knowledge Graph Completion Using Structure-Aware Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2407.12703v5 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-tuning pre-trained language models (PLMs) has recently shown a potential to improve knowledge graph completion (KGC). However, most PLM-based methods focus solely on encoding textual information, neglecting the long-tailed nature of knowledge graphs and their various topological structures, e.g., subgraphs, shortest paths, and degrees. We claim that this is a major obstacle to achieving higher accuracy of PLMs for KGC. To this end, we propose a Subgraph-Aware Training framework for KGC (SATKGC) with two ideas: (i) subgraph-aware mini-batching to encourage hard negative sampling and to mitigate an imbalance in the frequency of entity occurrences during training, and (ii) new contrastive learning to focus more on harder in-batch negative triples and harder positive triples in terms of the structural properties of the knowledge graph. translated_title: 基于结构感知对比学习的子图感知语言模型训练方法用于知识图谱补全
translated_abstract: 微调预训练语言模型（PLM）近来展现出提升知识图谱补全（KGC）性能的潜力。然而，大多数基于PLM的方法仅专注于编码文本信息，忽视了知识图谱的长尾分布特性及其多样的拓扑结构，例如子图、最短路径和节点度数。我们认为这是阻碍PLM在KGC任务上达到更高准确率的主要障碍。为此，我们提出了一种面向KGC的子图感知训练框架（SATKGC），包含两个核心思想：（i）子图感知的小批量采样策略，以促进困难负样本采样，并缓解训练过程中实体出现频率的不平衡问题；（ii）一种新的对比学习方法，基于知识图谱的结构特性，更加关注批内更难的负三元组和更难的正三元组。据我们所知，这是首个全面融合知识图谱结构信息的此类研究。
tldr: 该论文提出子图感知训练框架SATKGC，通过子图感知小批量采样与结构感知对比学习，将知识图谱的拓扑结构信息融入预训练语言模型的微调过程，从而提升知识图谱补全的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SATKGC, a subgraph-aware training framework that incorporates knowledge graph structural information into PLM fine-tuning through subgraph-aware mini-batching and structure-aware contrastive learning, improving knowledge graph completion accuracy.
